_comment: Bouts confirmed by hand that no source in the pipeline carries.
Folded in by scripts/build_roster_records.py on every run, so a rebuild cannot wipe them.
Each row is written from BOTH corners: an athlete's record should contain her own bout, and
the mirror-pair dedup in bracket_export collapses the two views for any test that needs a
bout counted once. `source: manual` keeps them distinguishable from anything scraped.

bouts.note: IBJJF Pan Championship, March 2025, brown belt absolute quarter-final. Absent from every source: Helena Crevar's BJJ Heroes record carries 48 bouts of which 45 are no-gi and ZERO are IBJJF gi, so her gi results are missing wholesale rather than this one being skipped.
